title: postgres-component-opt-in
rationale: Opt-in via kustomize Component keeps base overlay-free; DSN needs no sslmode in-cluster; image major tracks Supabase source for same-major pg_restore cutover.

name: pg-migrate-cutover-tooling
description: Cutover tooling pattern: scripts/pg-migrate wraps pg_dump/pg_restore for the Supabase-to-in-cluster cutover; parity.ts compares row counts, max(events.id), max(runs.created_at) and drizzle.__drizzle_migrations hashes and exits non-zero with a diff table. Pre-commit hook runs full check:all, so plain bun install at root is not enough — install src/ui and extensions/judge workspaces or check:deps/check:coverage fail.

content: Backup layer manifests live in deploy/k8s/components/postgres/backup/ and are pulled in by the parent component kustomization (file list, not a nested Component include), so a single overlay include renders all 8 objects. pg_dump and gcloud storage ship in different images, so backup pods use an emptyDir handoff: postgres:17 container runs pg_dump, google/cloud-sdk:slim runs gcloud storage cp. The prose guard (scripts/check-prose.ts) counts em dashes, semicolons and passive voice against a frozen per-file budget in scripts/prose-budgets.json — write short declarative sentences in RUNBOOK-K8S additions.

name: in-cluster-postgres-rehearsal
description: In-cluster Postgres rehearsal recipe (pl-6076): pg_dump from the Supabase pooler DSN with ?uselibpqcompat=true STRIPPED (libpq rejects it) via docker postgres:17 -Fc -n public -n drizzle --no-owner --no-privileges (~93 MB); kubectl cp into postgres-0 and pg_restore --no-owner (43 s, one ignorable 'schema public exists'); shadow warren = kubectl port-forward postgres-0 15432 + WARREN_BIND_PORT=8099 WARREN_DB_URL=... bun run src/cli/main.ts serve --no-auth (PORT env is ignored). Boot reconciliation marks runs that were live at dump time as lost, so the real cutover dumps only after warren is scaled to 0. Job pod templates are immutable: parameterise the restore Job by cloning it, not kubectl set env (warren-a413).
